source: Synthetic data; subjects adapted from historical T3 visuals research.

cases.subject: status board
cases.prompt: Show a T3 release status board. Keep built, tested, merged and installed distinct; identify every lane on hover.
cases.expected_output: Self-contained inline T3 HTML preserving the supplied meaning.

assertions.claim: The form answers the supplied question and honors its reference.
Values, population, units, periods and unknowns match the input; no unsupported claims.
The whole scroll surface has compact labels and no explanatory prose blocks.
Every status-bearing row/mark has the correct color and a non-color state cue.
Omitted per-item precision appears immediately as one unclipped line on hover and keyboard focus.
All displayed tooltip content including pseudo-elements computes to normal font-style.
All text and badge contrast measures at least 4.5:1 in light and dark.
Essential labels and units remain readable without overlap at 1280 and 390 pixels.
Visible wall clocks use Asia/Jerusalem local human time with correct DST conversion.
